name: Alyssa Hayes
source:
A COSA special agent, Alyssa works undercover in intelligence gathering and surveillance. Behind her unassuming, inexperienced appearance lies an attentive and disciplined observer who uses her ability to go unnoticed to blend into the environments she monitors. Reserved and meticulous, she approaches her assignments with a strong sense of duty and respect for the chain of command.
